mechanism_claims.claim_text: BR2GK and several truncated analogs permeabilize the Staphylococcus aureus plasma membrane at 50 µM; [P14]BR2GK(1-25)a is the negative analog in this assay.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: BR2GK, BR2GK(1-25)a, [A14], [K14], [R14] analogs; [P14] analog as low/non-permeabilizing comparator
mechanism_claims.limitations: Figure/prose supports comparative membrane permeabilization; exact per-bar percentages are not source-tabulated in local materials.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: BR2GK and truncated analogs affect Pseudomonas aeruginosa outer membrane permeability in the NPN assay at 50 µM, with strongest source-supported effects for BR2GK(1-25)a and [A14]BR2GK(1-25)a.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The outer-membrane assay is mechanistic context and does not override Table 2 MIC/MBC outcomes.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CD spectra show LPS/TFE-induced helical folding for most peptides and loss of helical folding for the P14 analog, supporting a structure-activity interpretation rather than a standalone killing mechanism.
mechanism_claims.limitations: CD is structural support; mechanism strength remains contextual unless paired with direct membrane assays.
